summary.text: Ian Richardson is the Democratic candidate for the Indiana House of Representatives, District 79, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Matthew Lehman.
A licensed pharmacy technician and lifelong resident of Bluffton, he lists labor law enforcement and infrastructure among his priorities.

paragraphs.text: Ian Richardson graduated from Norwell High School.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a lifelong resident of Bluffton, Indiana, with 20 years in the food service industry and a career as a freelance IT technician, and that he is now a licensed pharmacy technician.
He described himself as a working-class father who gets around his district on an electric scooter.
Richardson advanced from the Democratic primary for District 79 on May 5, 2026, without a primary opponent.
He said in his survey that he is running as an independent on the Democratic ticket.

His stated priorities include stricter fines for anti-union actions, mandatory triple damages for wage theft, higher and more stable wages, medical debt, and infrastructure and transportation accessibility.
